The '''Neutralizer''' was an experimental device that was created by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. These tower shaped machines generated an unknown energy field that caused disruptions in standard-issue weaponry that caused them to cease to function. In some cases, the effects of the Neutralizer were known to cause weapons and other equipment to explode in the hands of their users. Such an effect thus deprived potential enemies of their weaponry though more advanced equipment was capable of ignoring the effects of the device.

In the Cold War, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire deployed a prototype Neutralizer on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that greatly affected the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the fighting for the world. As a result, members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] tasked a spacer with the destruction of the device.
